Both E1/E2 trace to F=13 faces (lengths 11x4+2x6, sum 56) under both predecessor and successor conventions, hence genus 3 by Euler V-E+F=2-2g. Brute-force canonical labels over all 24*5040 S4xS7 relabellings differ (E1!=E2); mirrors also distinct under both conventions. Exhaustive enumeration of all 4*(5040-1)+7*(24-1)=20317 non-identity single-vertex reorderings per embedding finds exactly 45 genus-3 neighbours, all cyclic shifts (24+21), zero non-shift. Hence both are isolated vertices and the flip-graph is disconnected. Minor DRAFT arithmetic slip writing 20321 for 20317 does not affect the proof.

material_sources.relationship_to_claim: This thesis defines a configuration graph of embeddings whose adjacency is a single-vertex local-rotation change, which is analogous in formulation to the submitted flip-graph. But its object class is cubic graphs with binary stable/unstable states relative to a fixed base embedding, whereas K(4,7) has vertex degrees 7 and 4 and is therefore outside that class, and it proves no K(4,7) genus-3 witness isolation result.
